messages:
Carmen: dropped a compact scorecard preview prototype in Figma — focuses on dense rows, inline verdict chips, and a small preview pane. want quick UX + a11y nits before handing to eng. screenshot attached.
Vik: Nice start. two quick items: active row highlight feels faint in compact mode; bump left accent to 3px and increase bg tint slightly. also ensure row height never drops below 40px for touch.
Hiro: Keyboard: up/down to move, Space to select, Enter to open preview. visible focus ring for the compact row, and `aria-selected` updates on selection. add `aria-live` region for bulk actions: "3 items selected".
Leah: Copy nits: verdict chips read "Pass/Fail" 12; prefer "No regression / Regression" for clarity in audit logs. Tooltip for chip should include reason: e.g., "Regression: lower answer quality on step 2".
Carmen: Good call on copy. For preview pane I want a tiny inline diff snippet (max 3 lines) + link "Open full diff" that deep-links into the eval run.
Vik: Accessibility colors: red/orange/green chips must meet 3:1 on the white card. if we can't, add an icon and change label to explicit text. avoid color-only indicators.
Hiro: Screen reader specifics: when preview opens announce "Preview opened for <test-name>. Press Esc to close." trap focus inside preview and return focus to row on close. For the inline snippet, use `role=region` with an accessible name.
Leah: Microcopy: bulk actions dropdown currently says "Actions". change to "Bulk actions" and list verbs as "Approve as resolved", "Mark as ignored". In confirm modals include count and criticals: "Approve 4 diffs (1 critical)".
Carmen: Compactness debate: default compact = 48px rows, denser = 40px. Offer user toggle in view menu and remember per-user preference. Also allow keyboard preference to respect reduced-motion.
Vik: Visual hint: when rows are truncated add an inline ellipsis tooltip on hover with a 120ms fade; avoid instant popups. On mobile, expand row into full-screen card for easier reading.
Hiro: For the preview snippet we should include an aria-live polite update when content loads (some previews come from async eval runs). e.g., `aria-live="polite"` text "Preview ready". Also add `aria-busy` while loading.
Leah: Audit requirement: every approve action must attach a reason string. update copy to require a short reason (optional in UI but captured in API). toast should say "Approved 12 Undo" for 8s.
DevBot: system: perf note 12 rendering 500+ rows in one view -> recommend windowing (react-window) + virtualization. also suggest server-side truncation for preview snippets.
EvalBot: automated: eval run 2210 attached. summary: 30 diffs, 7 regressions. PR #712 will expose per-row preview endpoint.
Carmen: OK I'll update Figma with 48px/40px variants, clear copy updates, aria snippets for preview region, and the toggle in view menu. will post spec + a lightweight checklist for eng (keyboard, focus, live regions, color-contrast report). ping for a quick review tomorrow. :sparkles:
